title: FloodPay Policies per Location and Standing Alongside Indemnity Flood Insurance
content:
## Policy condition — FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines): one live policy per location

**Clause 1 (locations and live policies).** A customer may hold FloodPay policies on several locations, but no more than the tier's limit of policies per location may be live on one location: a policy is bound only when no other FloodPay policy at the same location address is in status pending installation, active or sensor fault. The product sets no separate cap on the number of FloodPay policies one customer may hold across different locations.

**Clause 2 (standing alongside indemnity cover).** A FloodPay policy pays on its own trigger and is never combined with, reduced by or coordinated with any indemnity flood policy on the same property. Because FloodPay cannot satisfy a lender's mandatory purchase requirement, it never satisfies a lender's flood insurance requirement.

### What decides Clause 1

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| The object compared | The location address of the policy to be bound, against the location address of every other FloodPay policy |
| The evidence | The company's policy records — location address and status — as they stand before the policy is bound; the customer's own account of other cover at the address is not the basis |
| Statuses that make another policy live | Pending installation, active, sensor fault |
| Statuses that do not appear in the clause | Expired, cancelled |

### Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

- *Hypothetical case A.* The address has a FloodPay policy in status active. A further FloodPay policy at that address is not bound.
- *Hypothetical case B.* The address has a FloodPay policy that is still pending installation, its sensor not yet reporting. That policy is live under Clause 1, so a further FloodPay policy at that address is not bound.
- *Hypothetical case C.* The address has a FloodPay policy whose cover is suspended for a sensor fault. That policy is live under Clause 1, so a further FloodPay policy at that address is not bound.
- *Hypothetical case D.* A customer already holds an active FloodPay policy on one address and applies for FloodPay on a different address. Clause 1 compares policies at the same location address only, so the policy at the first address is not one the clause counts against the second.
- *Hypothetical case E.* The same property also carries an indemnity flood policy. Under Clause 2 a FloodPay payout is made on FloodPay's own trigger, and the indemnity policy neither reduces it nor is combined or coordinated with it.

### Basis Q&A

**Can a FloodPay policy be offered to meet a mortgage lender's flood insurance requirement?**
No. FloodPay never satisfies a lender's flood insurance requirement.

**Does an expired or cancelled FloodPay policy at the same address count as live?**
The clause names only the statuses pending installation, active and sensor fault as the ones that stand in the way of binding.
